lead.titleZh: APTA 峰会推动支付改革，行业关注持续增加
lead.titleEn: APTA Summit Drives Payment Reform, Industry Focus Grows
lead.paragraphZh: 今日日报共包含 11 个条目，覆盖 5 个专业领域。其中，行业与执业方向有 3 条值得关注，最高分条目（85 分）来自 APTA，聚焦支付改革的倡导。此外，有 4 项观察研究、2 项系统综述和 1 项 RCT 值得审视。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's daily report features 11 entries across 5 specialties. Of note, 3 items address industry and practice, with the highest-scoring entry (85) from APTA focusing on payment advocacy. Additionally, 4 observational studies, 2 systematic reviews, and 1 RCT warrant review.

items.title: Sensory integration strategies for static balance control in older adults with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A study with 69 knee osteoarthritis patients explored sensory integration strategies in static balance control, finding potential over-reliance on visual and vestibular inputs when proprioception is challenged.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示膝骨关节炎患者在平衡控制上可能过度依赖视觉和前庭系统。这提醒您评估这类患者时，注意其在本体感觉受损情况下的平衡代偿策略。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎老年患者静态平衡控制中的感觉整合策略
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 69 名膝骨关节炎患者的研究发现，他们在静态平衡控制中可能存在对视觉和前庭感觉的过度依赖，尤其是在本体感觉受损时。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that patients with knee osteoarthritis may over-rely on visual and vestibular systems for balance control. This highlights the importance of assessing compensatory balance strategies in these patients, especially when proprioception is compromised.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性设计，样本量较小，且无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational study with a small sample size, and it cannot establish causality.

items.title: Predictors of physical and mental health in youth with disabilities: the role of Paralympic sport participation | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A study with 1,134 participants (mean age: 17.46 years) found that Paralympic sport participation significantly predicts better physical and mental health in youth with disabilities, as assessed by the SF-12 questionnaire.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 1134 名残疾青少年的研究强调了残奥运动对身心健康的益处。在为有残疾的青少年制定康复计划时，你可以考虑将参与适应性体育活动纳入其中。
items.titleZh: 残疾青少年身心健康的预测因素：残奥运动参与的作用
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 1134 名残疾青少年（平均年龄：17.46 岁）的研究发现，残奥运动参与显著预测了受试者更好的身心健康，并通过 SF-12 问卷进行了评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study involving 1,134 youth with disabilities highlights the benefits of Paralympic sport for physical and mental health. When developing rehabilitation plans for youth with disabilities, consider incorporating participation in adaptive sports activities.
items.limitation: 研究依赖自我报告的健康问卷，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study relied on self-reported health questionnaires, which may introduce recall bias.

items.title: The effects of a falls prevention app (SAFE app) on community-dwelling adults' fall risk category: Single-blinded randomized control pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded randomized controlled pilot trial (N=54) found that a 12-week app-based home exercise program, combined with educational pamphlets, positively impacted community-dwelling older adults' fall risk category compared to pamphlets alone.
items.curatedReason: 这款防跌倒 App 对社区老年人的跌倒风险分类有积极影响，但仅是小样本的初步试验，外推到大规模应用前需要更多证据。目前可作为辅助工具了解。
items.titleZh: 防跌倒 App（SAFE app）对社区老年人跌倒风险分类的影响：单盲随机对照初步试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照初步试验（N=54）发现，为期 12 周的基于 App 的家庭锻炼计划结合教育手册，相较于单独使用手册，对社区老年人的跌倒风险分类有积极影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This falls prevention app shows a positive impact on fall risk categorization in community-dwelling older adults. However, it's a small pilot trial, and more evidence is needed before widespread adoption. Consider it an assistive tool for now.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步试验（N=54），结果的外推性有限，且随访期较短。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot trial (N=54) with limited generalizability and a short follow-up period.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of diurnal variation in single bout of resistance training on cardiopulmonary functions among postmenopausal females | Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy
items.summary: This original research article explored the effect of diurnal variation in a single bout of resistance training on cardiopulmonary functions among postmenopausal females, suggesting potential time-of-day influences.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本研究提示，阻力训练对绝经后女性心肺功能的影响可能存在昼夜节律。你在开具阻力训练处方时，可以把训练时间纳入考量，未来关注更大样本的研究是否会支持这一趋势。
items.titleZh: 单次阻力训练的昼夜节律对绝经后女性心肺功能影响的研究
items.summaryZh: 这项原创研究文章探讨了单次阻力训练的昼夜节律对绝经后女性心肺功能的影响，提示了训练时间可能产生的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small-sample study suggests a potential diurnal variation in the effect of resistance training on cardiopulmonary functions in postmenopausal women. You might consider training time when prescribing resistance training, and watch for larger studies that may support this trend.
items.limitation: 本研究为单次训练的观察，未能提供长期训练的昼夜节律影响。
items.limitationEn: This study observed a single bout of training and did not provide information on the diurnal effects of long-term training.

items.title: Patient Education and Self-Management in Adults With Temporomandibular Disorders: Results From a Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis found patient education and self-management to be effective interventions for adults with temporomandibular disorders (TMD).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述证实，患者教育和自我管理对成人颞下颌关节紊乱（TMD）是有效的。你在临床实践中应优先整合这些低成本、高依从性的干预措施。
items.titleZh: 成人颞下颌关节紊乱患者教育与自我管理：系统综述与 Meta 分析结果
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 Meta 分析的系统综述发现，患者教育和自我管理是成人颞下颌关节紊乱（TMD）的有效干预措施。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review confirms that patient education and self-management are effective for adults with temporomandibular disorders (TMD). You should prioritize integrating these low-cost, high-adherence interventions into your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本系统综述可能包含不同类型和质量的原始研究。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review may include original studies of varying types and quality.

items.title: Multimodal Phenotyping of Myofascial Pain Syndrome Using Rotational Shear Wave Elastography and Clinical Network Analysis
items.summary: A study involving 71 adults suggests that multi-angle shear wave elastography, combined with bioimpedance spectroscopy and patient-reported outcomes, can characterize upper-trapezius anisotropy and differentiate subgroups of myofascial pain syndrome, providing more objective phenotyping.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，旋转剪切波弹性成像 (SWE) 结合生物阻抗和患者报告结果，可以为肌筋膜疼痛综合征提供更客观、多模态的表型分析。这有助于未来精准诊断和个性化治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 多模态表型分析肌筋膜疼痛综合征：旋转剪切波弹性成像与临床网络分析的应用
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 71 名成年人的研究表明，多角度剪切波弹性成像结合生物阻抗谱和患者报告结果，可以表征斜方肌上部的各向异性，并区分肌筋膜疼痛综合征的亚组，提供更客观的表型分析。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that rotational shear wave elastography (SWE), combined with bioimpedance and patient-reported outcomes, can provide a more objective, multimodal phenotyping for myofascial pain syndrome. This aids in future precise diagnosis and personalized treatment.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，且样本量相对较小（n=71），还需要更大型的队列研究和临床试验来验证这些发现的诊断和预后价值。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study with a relatively small sample size (n=71); larger cohort studies and clinical trials are needed to validate the diagnostic and prognostic value of these findings.

items.title: Governor Vessel Acupuncture Shows Neuroprotective Benefits in Experimental Ischemic Stroke: Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A meta-analysis of experimental evidence suggests that acupuncture targeting the governor vessel (GV) may offer neuroprotective benefits in ischemic stroke models.
items.curatedReason: 这项基于动物实验的 Meta 分析提示，督脉针灸在缺血性卒中中可能具有神经保护作用。考虑到目前缺乏人体 RCT 证据，别将其作为常规推荐，但可探索其作为辅助干预的潜力。
items.titleZh: 督脉针灸在实验性缺血性卒中中显示神经保护益处：Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对实验证据的 Meta 分析表明，靶向督脉（GV）的针灸可能在缺血性卒中模型中提供神经保护益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This animal-based meta-analysis suggests that Governor Vessel acupuncture might offer neuroprotective benefits in ischemic stroke. Given the current lack of human RCT evidence, do not consider it a routine recommendation, but explore its potential as an adjunctive intervention.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于动物实验，结果外推到人体需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to animal experiments; results should be extrapolated to humans with caution.

items.title: Chemical Neurolysis May Provide Long-Lasting Pain Relief in AVN-Related Hip Pain: Study Shows
items.summary: A study suggests that chemical neurolysis targeting anterior hip capsular branches can provide up to six months of pain relief for patients with avascular necrosis (AVN)-related hip pain unresponsive to conservative treatment.
items.curatedReason: 对于保守治疗无效的股骨头坏死（AVN）相关髋痛患者，化学神经溶解术可能提供长达六个月的疼痛缓解。这提示我们，在传统方案受限时，它可作为一种潜在的辅助疼痛管理选项。
items.titleZh: 研究显示：化学神经溶解术可为股骨头坏死相关髋痛提供持久缓解
items.summaryZh: 一项研究表明，针对髋关节前囊分支的化学神经溶解术可以为对保守治疗无效的股骨头坏死（AVN）相关髋痛患者提供长达六个月的疼痛缓解。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with avascular necrosis (AVN)-related hip pain unresponsive to conservative treatment, chemical neurolysis may offer up to six months of pain relief. This suggests it can be a potential adjunctive pain management option when traditional conservative approaches are limited.
items.limitation: 本研究为简短的技术报告，样本量和随访期可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This study is a brief technical report, and its sample size and follow-up period may be limited.

items.title: Advocates, Leaders Drive Payment Momentum During APTA Payment Advocacy Summit
items.summary: The APTA Payment Advocacy Summit gathered 450 advocates to build on recent state payment wins in 2025-2026, emphasizing the association's top priority: advancing payment for physical therapist services.
items.curatedReason: APTA 支付倡导峰会强调了 PT 报销政策的最新进展和未来方向。你应密切关注 APTA 在州和联邦层面的报销改革工作，这直接影响你的诊所收入和患者可及性。
items.titleZh: 倡导者、领导者在 APTA 支付倡导峰会期间推动支付改革
items.summaryZh: APTA 支付倡导峰会汇聚了 450 名倡导者，旨在巩固 2025-2026 年在州级支付方面取得的成就，并强调了该协会的首要任务：推动物理治疗师服务的支付改革。
items.curatedReasonEn: The APTA Payment Advocacy Summit highlighted the latest advancements and future directions in PT reimbursement policies. You should closely follow APTA's reimbursement reform efforts at both state and federal levels, as this directly impacts your clinic's revenue and patient access.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Social media behind nearly half of all racism and discrimination complaints
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) reported that social media is implicated in nearly half of all racism and discrimination complaints against health practitioners.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康执业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 报告称，近半数歧视投诉与社交媒体有关。你在使用社交媒体时，务必严格遵守专业行为准则，避免不当言论，维护你的执业形象和资质。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康执业者监管机构：近半数种族主义和歧视投诉与社交媒体相关
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康执业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 报告称，近半数针对健康执业者的种族主义和歧视投诉与社交媒体有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) reports that nearly half of all discrimination complaints are linked to social media. When using social media, you must strictly adhere to professional conduct guidelines, avoid inappropriate remarks, and protect your professional image and credentials.

items.title: Medicare Part D 2027 National Average Monthly Bid Amount Information
items.summary: CMS has released information regarding the Medicare Part D 2027 National Average Monthly Bid Amount, a key metric for drug plan pricing and beneficiary costs.
items.curatedReason: Medicare Part D 的平均月度出价金额间接影响患者的药物可及性和自付费用，最终可能影响对药物治疗依从性有赖的患者康复进程。了解这类政策动态有助于你更好地与患者沟通，并理解其整体医疗成本负担。
items.titleZh: Medicare Part D 2027 年全国平均每月出价金额信息发布
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 发布了 Medicare Part D 2027 年全国平均每月出价金额信息，这是药品计划定价和受益人成本的关键指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Medicare Part D average monthly bid amount indirectly affects patients' drug accessibility and out-of-pocket costs, which can impact adherence to medication regimens crucial for rehabilitation. Understanding these policy dynamics helps you better communicate with patients and appreciate their overall healthcare cost burden.
